items.title: Blue Jays top Royals, over .500 for first time in 5 months
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Kazuma Okamoto's fourth hit of the night went for a tiebreaking, seventh-inning RBI single, and the Toronto Blue Jays made it hold to win their fourth straight, 4-3 over the host Kansas City Royals on Saturday, to move above .500 for the first time since early April.
items.body:
Kazuma Okamoto's fourth hit of the night went for a tiebreaking, seventh-inning RBI single, and the Toronto Blue Jays made it hold to win their fourth straight, 4-3 over the host Kansas City Royals on Saturday, to move above .500 for the first time since early April.
With the game tied 3-3, Kansas City's Craig Kimbrel (1-3) walked George Springer, who then stole second base. With two out, Nathan Lukes grounded to shortstop Bobby Witt Jr., whose throw pulled first baseman Vinnie Pasquantino off the bag to extend the inning. Okamoto then grounded a single to center, bringing home Springer.
The Royals (63-80) put runners on first and second with nobody out in the eighth against Tyler Rogers, but Pasquantino bounced into a 1-6-3 double play and Michael Massey then grounded out to first. Louis Varland pitched a scoreless ninth for his 33rd save as the Blue Jays (72-71), who have a winning record for the first time since sitting 4-3 on April 3, moved into a tie for the final American League wild-card spot.
Okamoto drove in two runs and Lukes had three hits with an RBI while Mason Fluharty (6-1) threw a scoreless inning to get the win. Meanwhile, Toronto starter Max Scherzer allowed three runs over 5 2/3 innings.
Kansas City's Seth Lugo gave up three runs on eight hits and two walks over five innings. He struck out one. Salvador Perez had two hits with an RBI and John Rave homered for the Royals, who have lost five of six.
Toronto opened the scoring with two out in the first. Vladimir Guerrero Jr. singled then scored from first base on Alejandro Kirk's infield hit coupled with third baseman Josh Rojas' throwing error. Lukes then followed with an RBI single to left.
The Royals answered in the bottom of the frame, however. Scherzer hit leadoff batter Carter Jensen, then Witt doubled to left. Jac Caglianone and Perez followed with RBI singles to tie the contest.
Toronto regained the lead in the third when Lukes singled and scored from first on Okamoto's double off the third base bag. But the Royals tied it again, this time on Rave's homer just inside the right field foul pole in the fourth.
Caglianone exited in the third inning due to left elbow soreness.
--Field Level Media

items.title: From boardroom chic to battling win, Osaka reaches US Open last 16
items.author: Shrivathsa Sridhar
items.creator: Shrivathsa Sridhar
items.summary: Naomi Osaka continued to impress with her style and staying power at the U.S. Open on Saturday as the Japanese 13th seed battled past Belgian Elise Mertens 6-3 3-6 7-5 to reach the fourth round.
items.body:
Naomi Osaka continued to impress with her style and staying power at the U.S. Open on Saturday as the Japanese 13th seed battled past Belgian Elise Mertens 6-3 3-6 7-5 to reach the fourth round.
For her latest eye-catching [USN:L4N44T05M TEXT:"walk-on"] look, the four-times major champion blended boardroom and locker-room aesthetics in a grey checked blazer-hoodie and wide-leg pants, putting a tailored twist on traditional pre-match attire.
The 28-year-old, a two-times champion at Flushing Meadows, reeled off three games in succession to take a 4-1 lead in the first set under the lights of Louis Armstrong Stadium, clinching it with a battling hold thanks to a string of booming serves.
Osaka pushed the 23rd seed hard at the start of the next set with some heavy hitting from the baseline before pouncing with a break in the third game, only to surrender the lead by dropping the next two games.
"Honestly, I can't believe I won this match," Osaka said, thanking the crowd for the energy they provided.
"There was a certain point where I put my heart on the court and kept trying in every point. Thank you so much, but honestly, I'm shocked I won. I'm not going to lie."
After levelling the match to force a decider, Mertens capitalised on several unforced errors by a frustrated Osaka to gain the upper hand, but there would be another momentum shift in the match after a medical timeout for the Japanese player.
"I didn't play amazing and it was getting me down, sorry about my behaviour, for the little kids watching," said Osaka, who threw her racket to the floor at one point.
"This is my favourite tournament. I wanted to play well in front of you. I'm just that glad I have the opportunity to play another match.
"I thought I was going to be ok, but clearly I was shaky."
After recovering a break late on, Osaka fired a huge ace to take a 6-5 lead and revved up her forehand in the following game to complete the win and earn a meeting with Elena Rybakina or Yuliia Starodubtseva in the round of 16.

JAKARTA, Sept 6 (Reuters) – An eruption of Indonesia’s Mount Anak Krakatau caused the suspension of hundreds of flights at Jakarta’s main airport on Sunday after some school activities and fishing were halted.

Soekarno-Hatta International Airport posted on Instagram that it had suspended flight operations until 9:30 a.m. (0230 GMT) due to volcanic ash.

   The suspension, extending a halt that had been scheduled until 5:30 a.m., has affected 209 flights, including several international flights, Indonesia’s transportation ministry said.

Show Full Article

   Anak Krakatau has erupted since late on Friday, with volcanic ash detected at the airport early on Sunday, the ministry said in a statement.

Ash was identified as high as 20,000 feet (6,000 metres) on the Java side of the volcano and a plume of up to 50,000 feet (15,000 metres) on the Sumatra side and some parts of Banten province in Java, the meteorological agency BMKG posted on its website.

Anak Krakatau is roughly halfway between Java and Sumatra in Indonesia’s vast island chain, which sits on the Pacific “Ring of Fire”, where earthquakes and volcanic eruptions are frequent.

Indonesia’s disaster mitigation agency, BNPB, “urges the public to remain calm while increasing vigilance. In the event of ashfall, people are advised to wear masks and eye protection, reduce outdoor activities, cover water sources and exercise caution when driving, as volcanic ash can reduce visibility,” said spokesperson Berton Panjaitan.

Several schools cancelled activities on Saturday with students and residents suffering eye irritation from the ash, while fishermen cancelled their fishing trips due to the eruption, local media outlet Kompas reported.

   The disaster mitigation agency said on Saturday there was no imminent risk of tsunami from the volcano.

A tsunami in 2018 caused by Anak Krakatau eruptions killed hundreds and injured hundreds more on Java and Sumatra.

Anak Krakatau, which means child of Krakatau, emerged a century ago from the area once occupied by Krakatau, then known as Krakatoa. Krakatoa was destroyed in 1883, when its massive eruptions killed more than 36,000 people in a series of tsunamis.

(Reporting by Bernadette Christina; Editing by William Mallard)

items.title: Rockies place ailing Willi Castro (heel) on IL
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The Colorado Rockies placed infielder/outfielder Willi Castro on the 10-day injured list Saturday due to left heel inflammation.
items.body:
The Colorado Rockies placed infielder/outfielder Willi Castro on the 10-day injured list Saturday due to left heel inflammation.
The move is retroactive to Wednesday.
Castro, 29, has been dealing with plantar fasciitis and hasn't played since Monday against the Baltimore Orioles.
Castro has smacked a career-high 15 homers while batting .260 with 56 RBIs in 120 games this season.
The versatile Castro has started 51 games at second base and 36 at third. He also has 15 starts at shortstop, six at first base and two in left field.
Castro has a .247 career average with 71 homers and 284 RBIs in 825 games with the Detroit Tigers (2019-22). Minnesota Twins (2023-25), Chicago Cubs (2025) and Rockies. He was an American League All-Star in 2024 for the Twins.
Colorado selected the contract of infielder Vimael Machin from Triple-A Albuquerque in a corresponding move.
This is the first stint in the majors this season for Machin, who turns 33 on Sept. 25. He has a .204 career average with two homers and 15 RBIs in 116 games with the Athletics (2020-22) and Orioles (2025).
Colorado also outrighted outfielder Tyler Freeman to Albuquerque after he cleared waivers to open up a 40-man roster spot for Machin. Freeman, 27, batted .247 with three homers and 23 RBIs in 79 games for the Rockies this season.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Yusei Kikuchi tosses 6 scoreless as Angels beat Pirates
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Yusei Kikuchi pitched six scoreless innings for his first win of the season and Josh Lowe hit a home run to lead the visiting Los Angeles Angels to a 6-1 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates on Saturday night.
items.body:
Yusei Kikuchi pitched six scoreless innings for his first win of the season and Josh Lowe hit a home run to lead the visiting Los Angeles Angels to a 6-1 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates on Saturday night.
Wade Meckler doubled twice and had two RBIs, Zach Neto went 3-for-5 with an RBI and Mike Trout added two hits and an RBI for Los Angeles (54-88), which snapped a three-game losing streak.
Making just his 10th start of the season after missing almost four months with left shoulder inflammation, Kikuchi (1-5) allowed five hits, walked three and struck out six to pick up his first win since Sept. 24, 2025, against Kansas City.
Bryan Reynolds went 3-for-3 with a home run and a walk and Rafael Flores Jr. had two hits, including a double, for Pittsburgh (70-73). Braxton Ashcraft (14-6) took the loss after allowing three runs on seven hits in five innings. He struck out nine, threw a wild pitch and did not issue a walk.
Los Angeles took a 1-0 lead in the fourth inning when Meckler doubled down the left-field line and scored one out later on a single by Moises Ballesteros.
The Angels extended the lead to 3-0 in the fifth inning. Lowe led off the frame with his 11th home run, a 410-foot blast to straightaway center. Denzer Guzman followed with a single, advanced to second on a sacrifice bunt, took third on a balk and scored on Neto's single to center.
Los Angeles broke the game open with three runs in the seventh inning off reliever Isaac Mattson. Adam Frazier doubled with one out and went to third on a single by Neto. Trout followed with an RBI single and Meckler then lined a double into the alley in right-center to drive in both Neto and Trout.
Reynolds ended the shutout with two outs in the bottom of the eighth when he clubbed his 16th home run of the season, a 421-foot drive over the bleachers in right field.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Tyler Reddick starts Chase from pole at Darlington after qualifying canceled
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: DARLINGTON, S.C. -- Inclement weather forced the cancellation of Busch Light pole qualifying at Darlington (S.C.) Raceway on Saturday evening, and no one was happier about the development than 23XI Racing's Tyler Reddick, who will now lead the field to green in the Cook Out Southern 500 to open The Chase on Sunday night (5 p.m. ET, USA Network, MRN, SiriusXM NASCAR Radio).
items.body:
DARLINGTON, S.C. -- Inclement weather forced the cancellation of Busch Light pole qualifying at Darlington (S.C.) Raceway on Saturday evening, and no one was happier about the development than 23XI Racing's Tyler Reddick, who will now lead the field to green in the Cook Out Southern 500 to open The Chase on Sunday night (5 p.m. ET, USA Network, MRN, SiriusXM NASCAR Radio).
This is the eighth time this season the five-time NASCAR Cup Series race winner and driver of the No. 45 Toyota will start from the No. 1 position on the grid -- five times through a formal qualifying session and three others as a result of a canceled session due to weather.
"This is literally the best-case scenario for us," said a smiling Reddick, who has now started among the top 10 at every Darlington race throughout his entire four-year career at 23XI Racing.
Reddick led 77 of the 293 laps and won from pole position here in March.
"We were so strong here in the spring," he said. "Ironically enough, as I kind of got going in Cup racing, it was during COVID with no practice at all and I got very used to just having to figure it out in the first corner.
"So for me, generally, I feel like we're in a really good spot most weekends when this happens. But beyond that, as strong as we were, I know teams may want to try things to close the gap, but no one had that opportunity today, so that helps us even more."
Reddick will share the front row with fellow title contender Daniel Suarez in the No. 7 Spire Motorsports Chevrolet. Chase drivers, Roush Fenway Keselowski's Ryan Preece and championship leader Denny Hamlin of Joe Gibbs Racing, will roll off third and fourth.
Hamlin, whose five career Darlington wins are the most in the field, won the regular-season title and starts the race with a 25-point advantage on the next-closest competitor in the 16-driver championship field.
Spire Motorsports' Michael McDowell, who is not championship-eligible, will start fifth. He is followed by a pair of Chase drivers, Team Penske's Austin Cindric and JGR's Chase Briscoe, who is the two-time defending race winner and the only other multi-time winner among the field.
Three non-Chase drivers -- HYAK Motorsports' Ricky Stenhouse Jr., Richard Childress Racing's Austin Dillon, and Hendrick Motorsports' Alex Bowman -- round out the top 10 on the grid.
The rainout performance metric has made for an interesting challenge for several of the other Chase drivers. JGR's Christopher Bell starts 11th with Penske's Joey Logano -- a three-time series champion -- 13th on the grid. Reddick's 23XI Racing teammate Bubba Wallace will start 17th alongside Hendrick Motorsports' Chase Elliott -- tops on the grid among the three title-chasing Hendrick team Chevrolets.
Hendrick's William Byron (20th), Penske's Ryan Blaney (24th), JGR's Ty Gibbs (28th), Spire's Carson Hocevar (34th) and RFK's Chris Buescher (35th) round out the Chase field on the 38-car grid.
Logano, Larson and Byron are all former Darlington race winners.

items.title: Athletics place RHP J.T. Ginn (elbow) on 15-day injured list
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The Athletics placed starting pitcher J.T. Ginn on the 15-day injured list on Saturday because of a right elbow impingement.
items.body:
The Athletics placed starting pitcher J.T. Ginn on the 15-day injured list on Saturday because of a right elbow impingement.
The right-hander is eligible to come off the injured list on Sept. 20, but the Athletics haven't yet made a determination about whether he will pitch again this season.
In a corresponding move, the Athletics recalled right-hander Jack Perkins from Triple-A Las Vegas one day after optioning him to the affiliate.
In other moves on Saturday, the team recalled right-hander Seth Johnson from Las Vegas and optioned rookie righty Kade Morris to Triple A.
Ginn, 27, last pitched on Aug. 26, earning the win after going six innings and allowing four runs, six hits (including three home runs) and two walks with three strikeouts in the 7-4 home victory over the Minnesota Twins.
The Athletics flew in an orthopedist on Saturday to evaluate Ginn for what was described as general fatigue/soreness.
"We'll make a determination (Saturday) as to his future," Athletics manager Mark Kotsay said Friday. "You always want guys to finish the season, but we need to make the right decision for him going forward and his future, especially going into next year."
Ginn is 9-8 with a 3.71 ERA, 57 walks and 121 strikeouts in a career-high 138 1/3 innings over 27 games (24 starts) this season. He has a career mark of 14-16 with a 4.25 ERA, 97 walks and 249 strikeouts in 58 games (46 starts) over parts of the last three seasons with the Athletics.
Perkins, 26, is 3-10 with a 6.50 ERA, three saves, 47 walks and 116 strikeouts in 98 1/3 innings over 33 games (13 starts) this season.
He made his major league debut in 2025 and is a career 6-12 with a 5.85 ERA, six saves, 65 walks and 153 strikeouts in 137 innings over 45 games (17 starts).
Johnson, who turns 28 on Sept. 19, is 0-0 with a 13.50 ERA in 4 2/3 innings over five relief appearances with the Athletics since he was traded from the Philadelphia Phillies on Aug. 3 for outfielder Colby Thomas. Johnson was 1-0 with a 5.51 ERA in 16 1/3 innings over 16 relief appearances with the Phillies.
Morris, 24, was 0-1 with a 10.90 ERA, seven walks and 10 strikeouts in 17 1/3 innings over six games (two starts) for the Athletics. He started Friday's 7-6 win at Seattle and allowed five runs on five hits and one walk in 2 2/3 innings.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Indonésie-L'aéroport de Djakarta suspend les vols en raison de l'éruption de l'Anak Krakatau
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Les vols aériens ont été suspendus dimanche matin au principal aéroport de Djakarta, en Indonésie, en raison des cendres volcaniques rejetées par le volcan Anak Krakatau, entré en éruption vendredi soir.
items.body:
Les vols aériens ont été suspendus dimanche matin au principal aéroport de Djakarta, en Indonésie, en raison des cendres volcaniques rejetées par le volcan Anak Krakatau, entré en éruption vendredi soir.
L'aéroport Soekarno-Hatta a fait savoir sur le réseau social Instagram que les vols aériens seraient suspendus jusqu'à 09h30 heure locale (02h30 GMT).
Quelque 209 vols, dont plusieurs internationaux, ont été affectés, a déclaré le ministère indonésien des Transports.
Des nuages de cendres volcaniques ont perturbé les activités dans les provinces de Lampung, sur l'île de Sumatra, et de Banten, sur l'île de Java, a dit un porte-parole de l'agence nationale de gestion des catastrophes (BNPB).
Selon la BNPB, il n'existe aucun risque de tsunami dans l'immédiat.

items.title: サッカー＝アストンビラ鈴木が活躍、鎌田と田中はアシスト記録
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［ロンドン　５日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［ロンドン　５日　ロイター］ - サッカーのイングランド・プレミアリーグは５日、各地で試合を行い、ＧＫ鈴木彩艶が所属するアストンビラはハルとスコアレスドローに終わった。

鈴木はフル出場を果たし、４セーブをマーク。相手を無得点に抑えたが、アストンビラは開幕３試合で未勝利となった。ハルの守田英正はベンチ入りしなかった。

クリスタルパレスはフラムに３─２で勝利した。クリスタルパレスの鎌田大地は先発し、後半３２分にチームの決勝ゴールをアシスト。同４４分までプレーした。チームメートの冨安健洋はベンチ入りしたが、出場しなかった。

リーズはブライトンと１─１の引き分け。先発したリーズの田中碧は前半１５分にシュートのこぼれ球を折り返し、先制点をアシストした。田中は後半２８分に交代した。ブライトンの三笘薫はベンチ外。

坂元達裕が所属するコベントリーはマンチェスター・シティー（マンＣ）に０─１で敗れ、開幕３連敗となった。坂元はベンチ入りしたが、出番はなかった。アーリング・ハーランドが決勝ゴールを奪ったマンＣは開幕３連勝。

このほか、ニューカッスルはボーンマスと２─２のドロー。ブレントフォードはサンダーランドと１─１の引き分け。トットナム─ノッティンガム・フォレスト戦はスコアレスドローだった。

JAKARTA, Sept 6 (Reuters) – Indonesia’s Soekarno-Hatta international airport suspended flight operations until 9:30 a.m. (0230 GMT) on Sunday due to volcanic ash from the ongoing eruption of Mount Anak Krakatau, Jakarta’s main airport posted on Instagram.

   The suspension, extending a halt that had been scheduled until 5:30 a.m., has affected 209 flights, including several international flights, Indonesia’s transportation ministry said.

   Anak Krakatau has erupted since late on Friday, with volcanic ash detected in the airport early on Sunday, the ministry said in a statement.

Show Full Article

Dispersal of volcanic ash has disrupted activities in Lampung province in Indonesia’s Sumatra island and Banten province on Java, said Berton Panjaitan, a spokesperson for Indonesia’s disaster mitigation agency, BNPB.

“BNPB urges the public to remain calm while increasing vigilance. In the event of ashfall, people are advised to wear masks and eye protection, reduce outdoor activities, cover water sources and exercise caution when driving, as volcanic ash can reduce visibility,” he said.

Several schools cancelled activities on Saturday with students and residents suffering eye irritation from the ash, while fishermen cancelled their fishing trips due to the eruption, local media outlet Kompas reported.

   The disaster mitigation agency said on Saturday there was no imminent risk of tsunami from the volcano.

(Reporting by Bernadette Christina; Editing by William Mallard)

items.title: 【焦点】ECB、今年2回目の利上げへ－G7で最もタカ派的な姿勢鮮明に
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 欧州中央銀行（ECB）は、10日の政策委員会会合で今年2回目の利上げを決定するとほぼ確実視されている。焦点は、年内3回目の利上げにECB当局者がどこまで前向きかに移る。

ECBが0.25ポイント利上げに踏み切ることは広く示唆されており、主要7カ国（G7）で最もタカ派的な中銀という位置付けを改めて印象付ける動きとなる。議論はすでに次の一手の必要性に移りつつある。

長い夏休みを終え、新たな四半期経済予測を手にした政策当局者は、エネルギー輸入への依存度がなお高いユーロ圏で、中東での戦闘長期化と、燃料価格上昇が再び勢いづく可能性に直面している。

直近の統計では、ユーロ圏の8月のインフレ率は3.3%に上昇。約3年ぶりの高い伸びで、2%の目標を大きく上回る。インフレに比較的楽観的な見方を示す米連邦準備制度理事会（FRB）とは対照的に、ECBは予防的な引き締めの必要性を明言してきた。底堅い成長を示す材料は、その見方を補強しそうだ。

もっとも、ユーロ圏の直近のインフレ統計では、いわゆるコア指標が予想外に鈍化するなど、一定の安心材料となった。それでも当局者が危険を冒す気配はない。2022年の生活費高騰への対応が遅れたと批判された経緯もあるためだ。

3回目の利上げを巡る議論は微妙な局面を迎えそうだ。リトアニア中銀のシムカス総裁が9月の利上げだけでは不十分だとの見方を示した一方、ドイツ連邦銀行のナーゲル総裁はヒントを与えることに慎重だった。

投資家は12月の利上げをおおむね織り込んでいる。エコノミストの多くは10日に実施される見込みの引き締めが当面最後になるとの見方を示してきたが、そのコンセンサスにも変化の兆しが出ている。JPモルガン・チェースとソシエテ・ジェネラル、BNPパリバのアナリストはここ数日、いずれも予想を変更し、追加利上げを見込んだ。

9月15－16日の連邦公開市場委員会（FOMC）会合で、利上げに踏み切るかどうかは、政府のインフレ統計次第となりそうだ。4日発表の米雇用統計では労働市場の広範な底堅さが示された。

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
ラグビーのテストマッチ、リポビタンＤチャレンジカップは５日、新潟・デンカビッグスワンスタジアムで試合を行い、世界ランキング１２位の日本代表は同２４位のカナダ代表に５７─１２で圧勝した。

日本は岡部崇人、原田衛、ベン・ガンター、広瀬雄也と下川甲嗣がトライを決めて、３１─７で前半を終了。後半は原田とハリー・ホッキングスのトライの後、カナダにトライを決められたが、稲場巧、ティエナン・コストリーのトライで再び突き放した。

日本のフォワード陣が相手を圧倒。チームの９トライ中、８トライを奪った。日本ラグビーフットボール協会は１１月３０日、創立１００周年を迎える。

日本は１２日、パシフィック・ネーションズカップ準決勝（大阪府・東大阪市花園ラグビー場）で米国と対戦。カナダはフィジーと戦う。

items.title: フィギュア＝ロシア女子ワリエワ、中立資格が取り消しに
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
フィギュアスケート女子、ロシア人のカミラ・ワリエワ（２０）は、中立選手の資格が取り消しとなり、国際大会に出場できなくなった。情報筋が５日、ロイターに伝えた。

この情報筋の話によると、ワリエワは国際スケート連盟（ＩＳＵ）から書簡で、資格の取り消しを通達されたという。ワリエワ（当時１５歳）は２０２２年北京冬季五輪の期間中、２カ月前に採取されたサンプルが禁止薬物トリメタジジンに陽性反応を示した。この結果、スポーツ仲裁裁判所（ＣＡＳ）は２０２１年１２月２５日から４年間の資格停止処分と、その間の全ての成績を失格とする裁定を下していた。

ワリエワは団体でロシア・オリンピック委員会（ＲＯＣ）の１位に貢献していたが、ワリエワの順位点が無効となったことで、当時２位だった米国が金、日本が銀に繰り上がりとなった。同選手は今年２月、ロシア国内のジャンプ大会で競技復帰を果たしたが、ミラノ・コルティナ冬季五輪への出場資格はなかった。

ワリエワは団体でロシア・オリンピック委員会（ＲＯＣ）の１位に貢献していたが、ワリエワの順位点が無効となったことで、当時２位だった米国が金、日本が銀に繰り上がりとなった。同選手は今年２月、ロシア国内のジャンプ大会で競技復帰を果たしたが、ミラノ・コルティナ冬季五輪への出場資格はなかった。

ロシアが２０２２年にウクライナへの軍事侵攻を開始して以来、ロシア選手団は国際大会への出場が禁止に。しかしＩＳＵは厳しい審査を通った一部の個人選手に関して、中立の立場での参加を認めてきた。

items.title: Guadalajara golea como visitante y sube al segundo lugar en el torneo mexicano
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Guadalajara, el club más popular del fútbol mexicano, goleó el sábado por 3-0 como visitante al Atlético de San Luis y se ubicó en el subliderato del torneo Apertura.
items.body:
Guadalajara, el club más popular del fútbol mexicano, goleó el sábado por 3-0 como visitante al Atlético de San Luis y se ubicó en el subliderato del torneo Apertura.
Con su cuarto triunfo, las "Chivas" de Guadalajara subieron del quinto al segundo lugar general con 14 puntos, dos menos que el líder América.
En el partido disputado en el estadio Libertad Financiera de San Luis, el llamado "Rebaño Sagrado" se adelantó a los seis minutos cuando el guardameta Andrés Sánchez metió el balón a su propia portería tras pegarle en la espalda después de que Santiago Sandoval estrelló su remate en el poste derecho.
Tres minutos después, el equipo visitante aumentó su ventaja con un disparo de zurda de Ricardo Marín en el centro del área tras un pase de cabeza de Ángel Sepúlveda.
El tercer gol de Guadalajara cayó a los 80 minutos por conducto de Richard Ledezma, quien definió con un potente disparo cruzado dentro del área.
Más tarde se jugarán los partidos entre Tigres UANL-Necaxa y Atlas-Atlante.
El domingo, el vigente campeón Cruz Azul enfrentará a Santos Laguna.
Los encuentros entre Pumas UNAM-León, Puebla-Toluca, América-Tijuana y Querétaro-Monterrey se pospusieron debido a la participación de América, Toluca, León y Monterrey en la Leagues Cup.
En el inicio de la jornada, Pachuca venció el viernes por 2-0 como visitante a Bravos de Ciudad Juárez en el debut del argentino Gustavo Lema como director técnico del equipo derrotado.

items.title: Shohei Ohtani out of Dodgers' starting lineup for 3rd straight game
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Shohei Ohtani was out of the Los Angeles Dodgers' starting lineup for the third consecutive game Saturday as he continues to deal with lingering issues involving his neck, right biceps and left knee.
items.body:
Shohei Ohtani was out of the Los Angeles Dodgers' starting lineup for the third consecutive game Saturday as he continues to deal with lingering issues involving his neck, right biceps and left knee.
The superstar two-way player sat out of the Dodgers' 3-2 win on Thursday against the St. Louis Cardinals and their 5-3 win on Friday over the Washington Nationals.
Ohtani, a four-time MVP, was scheduled to hit in the batting cages Saturday prior to Los Angeles' home game against the Washington Nationals, manager Dave Roberts said. How Ohtani feels afterward could determine whether the six-time All-Star ends up on the injured list.
"If it doesn't feel good today," Roberts said, "then (the IL) certainly should be on the table."
The 32-year-old Ohtani is batting .279 this season with 30 home runs and 80 RBIs. He is hitting just .137 (7 for 51) with one home run over his past 13 games amid the physical issues.
Ohtani is 8-2 with a 1.79 ERA and 95 strikeouts in 85 2/3 innings across 14 starts this season. He has not pitched since July 3, and he has declined to speak to the media since Aug. 17.
The minimum stint on the injured list for a two-way player is 15 days, the same as it is for pitchers.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Riley Greene smacks two HRs to help Tigers defeat Guardians
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: All-Star outfielder Riley Greene had four RBIs in his ninth career multi-homer game as the visiting Detroit Tigers bounced back from a doubleheader sweep, beating the Cleveland Guardians 6-0 on Saturday night.
items.body:
All-Star outfielder Riley Greene had four RBIs in his ninth career multi-homer game as the visiting Detroit Tigers bounced back from a doubleheader sweep, beating the Cleveland Guardians 6-0 on Saturday night.
Framber Valdez (9-10) pitched seven scoreless innings, matching his season high, and allowed three hits. The left-hander struck out three, walked one and hit a batter in shutting down American League playoff-hopeful Cleveland (72-71).
The Guardians' lead over the Toronto Blue Jays for the final wild-card berth was sliced to one-half game, while Detroit (65-77) moved within 6 1/2 games of the spot.
Greene hit two solo home runs against Parker Messick (11-9), a 407-foot drive in the first and a 421-foot blast in the sixth, breaking a homer drought that lasted more than a month. His previous homer occurred on Aug. 4 against the Seattle Mariners.
Greene also scored three times. He delivered an RBI single in the third and an RBI double in the seventh, with Gleyber Torres scoring on both hits.
All-Star rookie Messick had a career-high 12 strikeouts over six innings and allowed three runs on seven hits and two walks. Cleveland's Austin Peterson made his major league debut with two scoreless innings of relief.
Dillon Dingler added a sacrifice fly later in the seventh, and Ben Malgeri collected his third hit with an RBI single that scored Greene and extended Detroit's lead to 6-0.
On Friday, Cleveland won both games in walk-off fashion. Brayan Rocchio's homer in the ninth and Travis Bazzana's RBI single in the 10th did the honors, respectively.
Rookie outfielder Chase DeLauter (right wrist sprain) was unavailable for the Guardians, but outfielder Angel Martinez and shortstop Rocchio were in the lineup after running into each other while pursuing a popup on Friday.
Tigers third baseman Hao-Yu Lee started Saturday's game, telling manager A.J. Hinch that he was not bothered by the left shin contusion that resulted from his collision with Austin Hedges at home plate in the second game of Friday's doubleheader.
--Field Level Media

Jakarta airport suspends flights due to Mount Anak Krakatau ash; SIA among affected airlines

International flights scheduled for Sunday that were delayed or cancelled include some to or from Singapore, Kuala Lumpur, Guangzhou, Hong Kong and Doha, according to the airport's website.

JAKARTA: Indonesia's Soekarno-Hatta international airport has extended its suspension of flight operations until 1.30pm (2.30pm, Singapore time) on Sunday (Sep 6) due to volcanic ash from the ongoing eruption of Mount Anak Krakatau, Jakarta's main airport posted on Instagram.
The suspension, extending a halt that had been scheduled until 5.30am (6.30am, Singapore time), has affected 209 flights, including several international flights, Indonesia's transportation ministry said. Jakarta's main airport is about 180km from Mount Anak Krakatau.
International flights scheduled for Sunday that were delayed or cancelled include some to or from Singapore, Kuala Lumpur, Guangzhou, Hong Kong and Doha, according to the airport's website.
Singapore Airlines (SIA) was among the airlines affected. The carrier cancelled two flights to and from Jakarta on Saturday. A third Jakarta-bound SIA flight that was originally scheduled for Saturday night was rescheduled to Sunday afternoon, while another flight that had been scheduled to depart from Jakarta to Singapore on Sunday morning was also delayed until 3.50pm.

"As the situation remains fluid, other SIA flights between Singapore and Indonesia may be affected," said the carrier. 
Passengers are advised to check SIA's flight status page for the latest information on their flights.
Mount Anak Krakatau has been erupting since late on Friday, with volcanic ash detected in the airport early on Sunday, the ministry said in a statement.

Mount Anak Krakatau volcano spews hot lava as seen from Pasauran village in Serang, Banten province, Indonesia, on Sep 5, 2026. (Photo: REUTERS/Rikardo)

Ash was identified as high as 6,000 metres on the Java side of the volcano and a plume of up to 15,000 metres on the Sumatra side and some parts of Banten province in Java, the meteorological agency BMKG posted on its website.
Anak Krakatau is roughly halfway between Java and Sumatra in Indonesia's vast island chain, which sits on the Pacific "Ring of Fire", where earthquakes and volcanic eruptions are frequent.
Indonesia's disaster mitigation agency, BNPB, "urges the public to remain calm while increasing vigilance. In the event of ashfall, people are advised to wear masks and eye protection, reduce outdoor activities, cover water sources and exercise caution when driving, as volcanic ash can reduce visibility," said spokesperson Berton Panjaitan.
Several schools cancelled activities on Saturday with students and residents suffering eye irritation from the ash, while fishermen cancelled their fishing trips due to the eruption, local media outlet Kompas reported.
The disaster mitigation agency said on Saturday there was no imminent risk of tsunami from the volcano.
A tsunami in 2018 caused by Anak Krakatau eruptions killed hundreds and injured hundreds more on Java and Sumatra.
Anak Krakatau, which means child of Krakatau, emerged a century ago from the area once occupied by Krakatau, then known as Krakatoa. Krakatoa was destroyed in 1883, when its massive eruptions killed more than 36,000 people in a series of tsunamis.

items.title: Allemagne-L'AfD vise une victoire historique en Saxe-Anhalt
items.author: Miranda Murray
items.creator: Miranda Murray
items.summary: Les électeurs de Saxe-Anhalt, Land de l'est de l'Allemagne, sont appelés aux urnes dimanche pour un scrutin régional lors duquel "Alternative pour l'Allemagne" (AfD) espère devenir le premier parti d'extrême droite à accéder au pouvoir au niveau régional depuis la Seconde guerre mondiale.
items.body:
Les électeurs de Saxe-Anhalt, Land de l'est de l'Allemagne, sont appelés aux urnes dimanche pour un scrutin régional lors duquel "Alternative pour l'Allemagne" (AfD) espère devenir le premier parti d'extrême droite à accéder au pouvoir au niveau régional depuis la Seconde guerre mondiale.
Mené par sa populaire tête de liste en Saxe-Anhalt - Ulrich Siegmund, 35 ans - l'AfD est crédité de plus de 40% d'intentions de vote dans le Land, avec une avance de 10 à 15 points sur la CDU, au pouvoir aux côtés du Parti social-démocrate (SPD) et du Parti libéral-démocrate (FDP).
Le scrutin est suivi de près par le gouvernement de Friedrich Merz alors que l'ampleur du soutien national au parti d'extrême droite a mis en évidence la transformation du paysage politique allemand depuis la création de l'AfD en 2013.
Obtenir une majorité absolue est un obstacle difficile à surmonter dans le système électoral allemand, conçu en partie pour favoriser les gouvernements de coalition et empêcher qu'un seul parti ne gouverne seul.
Si l'AfD ne parvient pas à obtenir la majorité absolue, un gouvernement dirigé par la CDU, sous la houlette du ministre-président sortant Sven Schulze, est le scénario le plus probable, même si la composition exacte d'une éventuelle coalition dépendra des partis qui y participeront.
Le scrutin de dimanche pourrait être suivi de plusieurs semaines de négociations de coalition.
L'AFD "NE PEUT PLUS ÊTRE ARRÊTÉ" Pour l'AfD, le scrutin de dimanche est une étape décisive vers son ambition nationale, remporter les prochaines élections fédérales allemandes en 2029.
"Quelle que soit l'issue du scrutin de demain, nous sommes déjà entrés dans l'histoire", a dit Ulrich Siegmund samedi soir lors d'un ultime événement de campagne.
"Car ce que nous avons commencé ici en Saxe-Anhalt, ce qui est en train de se propager à travers l'Allemagne, ne peut plus être arrêté", a-t-il affirmé.
Sans majorité absolue, il serait toutefois difficile pour l'AfD - qui a été classé comme un parti "extrémiste d'extrême droite" par les services de sécurité allemands - d'entrer au gouvernement.
Les résultats préliminaires sont attendus dimanche aux alentours de 18h00 (16h00 GMT).

items.title: Six-time Pro Bowl S Harrison Smith returns to Vikings
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Six-time Pro Bowl safety Harrison Smith agreed to return to the Minnesota Vikings for a 15th season, the team announced Saturday.
items.body:
Six-time Pro Bowl safety Harrison Smith agreed to return to the Minnesota Vikings for a 15th season, the team announced Saturday.
Smith, 37, had contemplated retirement in the offseason.
According to reports, Smith is expected to sign a deal worth $12.25 million plus incentives that could increase his pay to $16.25 million.
Smith (39 interceptions, 21.5 sacks) is one of six defensive backs in NFL history with at least 35 interceptions and 20 sacks in his career. The others are Hall of Famers Charles Woodson, Larry Wilson, Ronde Barber, LeRoy Butler and Brian Dawkins.
Smith was one of the top defensive players in the second half of last decade when he earned five of his six Pro Bowl nods. His other Pro Bowl selection came in 2021.
Smith has intercepted five passes in a season four times, topped 100 tackles twice and has notched three sacks on four occasions. He also had a career-best three forced fumbles in 2023.
Smith has 1,180 tackles, 13 forced fumbles and 10 fumble recoveries in 207 career regular-season games (203 starts). He has 55 tackles and one sack in eight career postseason games.
Last season, he had 54 tackles, two interceptions and one sack in 15 games (12 starts).
--Field Level Media

items.title: Zack Wheeler stifles Braves to help Phillies level series
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Zack Wheeler worked six strong innings and Kyle Schwarber hit his major league-leading 41st homer as the Philadelphia Phillies topped the visiting Atlanta Braves 4-2 on Saturday.
items.body:
Zack Wheeler worked six strong innings and Kyle Schwarber hit his major league-leading 41st homer as the Philadelphia Phillies topped the visiting Atlanta Braves 4-2 on Saturday.
Schwarber had two hits for Philadelphia, as did Bryce Harper, Derek Hill and Luis Arraez. Wheeler (12-5) struck out nine while allowing one run and three hits.
The Phillies (80-62) evened the four-game series at one win apiece and moved within four games of the first-place Braves (84-58) in the National League East.
Atlanta, which had won nine of its last 11, managed only five hits, including solo homers from Ronald Acuna Jr. and Austin Riley.
Braves starter Martin Perez (8-9) gave up four runs, seven hits and four walks in 3 2/3 innings.
The first three batters of the game reached against Wheeler, who escaped the jam by retiring the next three hitters.
Philadelphia also put together a quick rally in its half of the first. After issuing back-to-back walks to open the frame, Perez retired Harper for the first out before Arraez's single made it 1-0.
Perez then walked two of the next three hitters to force in another run.
The veteran left-hander got out of the inning without further damage, but he ran into immediate trouble in the second. Hill led off with a triple and came home on Schwarber's groundout.
Acuna's third-inning homer brought Atlanta within 3-1. However, Schwarber got that run back in the fourth with a long solo shot off Perez.
Wheeler struck out the side in the fifth and then retired the Braves in order in the sixth.
Riley cranked his 16th homer of the year against Jonathan Bowlan in the seventh to bring Atlanta within 4-2.
Jose Alvarado took over for Philadelphia in the eighth and yielded a leadoff single to Drake Baldwin before getting a double play off the bat of Acuna. The southpaw then struck out Matt Olson to end the inning.
Jhoan Duran had no issues in the ninth en route to his 30th save.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Indonesia's Anak Krakatau eruption halts flights, schools, fishing
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: An eruption of Indonesia's Mount Anak Krakatau caused the suspension of hundreds of flights at Jakarta's main airport on Sunday after some school activities and fishing were halted.
items.body:
An eruption of Indonesia's Mount Anak Krakatau caused the suspension of hundreds of flights at Jakarta's main airport on Sunday after some school activities and fishing were halted.
Soekarno-Hatta International Airport posted on Instagram that it had suspended flight operations until 9:30 a.m. (0230 GMT) due to volcanic ash.
The suspension, extending a halt that had been scheduled until 5:30 a.m., has affected 209 flights, including several international flights, Indonesia's transportation ministry said.
Anak Krakatau has erupted since late on Friday, with volcanic ash detected at the airport early on Sunday, the ministry said in a statement.
Ash was identified as high as 20,000 feet (6,000 metres) on the Java side of the volcano and a plume of up to 50,000 feet (15,000 metres) on the Sumatra side and some parts of Banten province in Java, the meteorological agency BMKG posted on its website.
Anak Krakatau is roughly halfway between Java and Sumatra in Indonesia's vast island chain, which sits on the Pacific "Ring of Fire", where earthquakes and volcanic eruptions are frequent.
Indonesia's disaster mitigation agency, BNPB, "urges the public to remain calm while increasing vigilance. In the event of ashfall, people are advised to wear masks and eye protection, reduce outdoor activities, cover water sources and exercise caution when driving, as volcanic ash can reduce visibility," said spokesperson Berton Panjaitan.
Several schools cancelled activities on Saturday with students and residents suffering eye irritation from the ash, while fishermen cancelled their fishing trips due to the eruption, local media outlet Kompas reported.
The disaster mitigation agency said on Saturday there was no imminent risk of tsunami from the volcano.
A [USN:KCN1OL0P1 TEXT:"tsunami in 2018"] caused by Anak Krakatau eruptions killed hundreds and injured hundreds more on Java and Sumatra.
Anak Krakatau, which means child of Krakatau, emerged a century ago from the area once occupied by Krakatau, then known as Krakatoa. Krakatoa was destroyed in 1883, when its massive eruptions killed more than 36,000 people in a series of tsunamis.

items.title: Une fusée allemande décolle avec succès de Norvège
items.author: Terje Solsvik
items.creator: Terje Solsvik
items.summary: La start-up allemande Isar Aerospace a procédé samedi avec succès au lancement de sa première fusée dans l'espace depuis un pas de tir situé dans l'Arctique norvégien.
items.body:
La start-up allemande Isar Aerospace a procédé samedi avec succès au lancement de sa première fusée dans l'espace depuis un pas de tir situé dans l'Arctique norvégien.
La fusée Spectrum est la première fusée commerciale à atteindre l'espace après avoir été lancée depuis l'Europe continentale.
"Nous sommes en orbite! Et nous venons d'entrer dans l'histoire de l'Europe", a écrit l'entreprise dans un message publié sur le réseau social X.
La ministre norvégienne de l'Industrie et du Commerce, Cecilie Myrseth, a salué le lancement de ce vol inhabité dans un communiqué.
"Le fait que nous puissions désormais lancer des satellites depuis Andoeya renforce la sécurité de la Norvège et de l'Europe en ces temps tumultueux", a-t-elle dit.

items.title: Germany's far-right AfD seeks landmark state victory as Saxony-Anhalt votes
items.author: Miranda Murray
items.creator: Miranda Murray
items.summary: The Alternative for Germany (AfD) could become the first far-right party to take power at a state level since World War Two. For the party, the closely watched state election on Sunday is a stepping stone towards its national ambitions.
items.body:
Voters in the eastern German state of Saxony-Anhalt will go to the polls on Sunday in a closely watched election that could see the Alternative for Germany (AfD) become the first far-right party to take power at a state level since the World War Two.
Under the smiling 35-year-old leader [USN:L8N44L1FP TEXT:"Ulrich Siegmund"], the party has been polling comfortably ahead for months, and there is a genuine chance the AfD could take an absolute majority on Sunday evening, particularly if several smaller parties fail to clear Germany's 5% threshold to enter parliament.
The vote is being closely watched as a barometer for the government of the deeply unpopular [USN:L8N43H14M TEXT:"Chancellor Friedrich Merz"], who has attempted to chip away at the AfD's popularity by taking a tougher line on [USN:L8N40I10X TEXT:"migration"] and security.
Recent surveys place the AfD at just over 40%, followed by Merz's Christian Democrats (CDU) at 23%.
An absolute majority would allow the AfD to bypass mainstream parties' efforts to keep the party blocked out of power by refusing to work with it under a longstanding "firewall" policy.
Achieving an absolute majority is a high bar to clear in Germany's proportional electoral system, which was designed in part to encourage coalition governments and make it difficult for one party to rule alone.
If the AfD falls short of an outright majority, a CDU-led administration under incumbent state premier Sven Schulze is the most likely outcome, though the exact shape of any coalition would depend on which parties enter.
Weeks of coalition talks could follow Sunday's vote.
AFD 'CAN NO LONGER BE STOPPED' For the AfD, the Saxony-Anhalt election is a stepping stone towards its larger ambitions of [USN:L1N44K02T TEXT:"securing national power"] in the next federal election scheduled for 2029.
"No matter the outcome of tomorrow's election, we have already made history," said Siegmund at a final rally on Saturday evening.
"Because what we have started here in Saxony-Anhalt -- what is currently sweeping across all of Germany -- can no longer be stopped," he told the crowd in Saxony-Anhalt's capital, Magdeburg.
However, without an absolute majority, the AfD, which has been classified as "far-right extremist" by the state security service, would struggle to enter government due to the firewall.
Such a result opens the prospect of [USN:L8N44T0M3 TEXT:"complex coalition negotiations"], dependent on which parties can hit the 5% hurdle.
Polls show one of the CDU's current coalition partners, the FDP, falling short, while the other, the SPD, is under 10%.
The small far-left BSW, the only party that has not ruled out a coalition with the AfD, is also likely to miss out.
For Schulze, who is favoured in polls as voters' top choice for leader, combining with the SPD and Greens might not be enough for a majority, but the CDU has ruled out a coalition with the far-left Left Party that could help it reach that threshold.
One option could be a minority government led by Schulze that would depend on passive tolerance from the Left - a model used in the neighbouring eastern German state of Thuringia.
Initial results are expected around 6 p.m. (1600 GMT) on Sunday evening shortly after polls close.

items.title: Michael Conforto, Ian Happ lead Cubs past Marlins
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Ian Happ drove in two runs, and Michael Conforto slugged a solo homer as the Chicago Cubs defeated the host Miami Marlins 6-5 on Saturday.
items.body:
Ian Happ drove in two runs, and Michael Conforto slugged a solo homer as the Chicago Cubs defeated the host Miami Marlins 6-5 on Saturday.
Ryan Zeferjahn got the final five outs without allowing a run to earn his first save with the Cubs and fifth of the season.
Conforto's homer was the major league-leading 200th of the season for the Cubs.
Griffin Conine led Miami with a two-run homer measured at 430 feet in the fifth inning. Kyle Stowers added the longest home run of his career, a 442-foot solo blast, in the seventh.
Chicago (81-62) will go for a three-game sweep of the Marlins (71-72) on Sunday.
Cubs starter Javier Assad allowed three runs on three hits and walked five across his 4 2/3 innings.
Ryan Gusto (1-4) took the loss for Miami after allowing five runs on 10 hits and two walks in 4 2/3 innings. The right-hander had a 1.88 ERA in six August starts.
Chicago threatened Gusto in the second inning as its first two batters singled. But Happ tried to go first-to-third on Nico Hoerner's single and was cut down on center fielder Jakob Marsee's one-hop throw. The inning ended when Hoerner was thrown out by catcher Joe Mack trying to steal third.
The Cubs opened the scoring in the third, when Conforto launched his leadoff homer 411 feet to center. Happ added a two-run single that came off his bat at 109.7 mph.
Chicago extended its lead to 4-0 in the fourth as catcher Miguel Amaya hustled his way to a double to shallow left, then scored on Pete Crow-Armstrong's two-out single to center.
Miami loaded the bases with no outs in the bottom of the fourth with an Otto Lopez double sandwiched between a pair of walks. Former Cub Owen Caissie and Mack then earned RBIs on groundouts.
Chicago made it 5-2 in the fifth when Michael Busch opened the frame with a double and later scored on Hoerner's two-out single that chased Gusto.
Assad exited with two outs in the fifth, and Caleb Thielbar allowed Conine's two-run homer, cutting Miami's deficit to 5-4.
Chicago got one back in the sixth on Busch's two-out RBI single to right.
Stowers' homer in the seventh again cut Miami's deficit to one run.
In the eighth, Miami's Esteury Ruiz smashed a one-out double to center. He was ultimately stranded when Deyvison De Los Santos grounded out and third baseman Alex Bregman made a nice fielding play to throw Javier Sanoja out at first to end the threat.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Shorthanded Argentina hold on for 28-28 second test draw with Wallabies
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Skipper Pablo Matera scored two tries as a brave Argentina effort earned them a 28-28 draw against Australia despite playing for the last 10 minutes with 13 men in the second test in Mendoza on Saturday.
items.body:
Skipper Pablo Matera scored two tries as a brave Argentina effort earned them a 28-28 draw against Australia despite playing for the last 10 minutes with 13 men in the second test in Mendoza on Saturday.
The Wallabies will take series honours after their 27-21 win in San Salvador de Jujuy last week, and remain unbeaten in four matches under new coach Les Kiss, but will rue not finishing off a shorthanded Pumas side.
Matera grabbed his second try to put the home side ahead for the first time in the 64th minute but calamity struck for the Pumas six minutes later.
Lucio Cinti was shown a yellow card for a deliberate knock-on and, from the resulting penalty, referee James Doleman sent Santiago Carreras to join him in the sin bin for the same infraction while awarding Australia a penalty try to level up the scores.
Australia's backline has not really fired yet under Kiss and that lack of fluency, along with a tendency towards error, cost them dearly as they chased the winning score.
"It's difficult to come here and do what we did," said Kiss. "But we know we let them off the hook. We took control, then let it go. Took control again, then let it go again.
"Series win, we get a trophy, but we know there's plenty we need to work on."
The Wallabies had started the match well and held a 14-0 lead after scoring two tries inside half an hour at a cool and windy Estadio Malvinas Argentinas.
Shortly after having a try called back for a foot in touch, recalled Australia captain Harry Wilson opened the scoring from close range in the 20th minute.
Pumas lock Franco Molina was sent to the sin bin in the 27th minute and the visitors quickly took advantage of the extra man to send winger Max Jorgensen across the line after the forwards had drawn in the defence.
Scrumhalf Ryan Lonergan converted both tries but the visitors were well aware they had held a similarly comfortable lead in the second test on their 2024 tour only to lose 67-27.
The Pumas duly hit back with two tries in four minutes before halftime after a yellow card shown to Australia lock Jeremy Williams evened up the numbers.
Matera crashed over under the posts before winger Ignacio Mendy flashed through the Australian defensive line in a well-worked move from a lineout.
Fullback Santiago Carreras slotted the conversions to level up the scores and Argentina could have gone into halftime with the lead had they kicked either of the penalties they were awarded on the Australia line just before the break.
Flanker Fraser McReight forced his way over the line to put Australia back ahead early in the second half but a similar converted try from Argentina hooker Ignacio Ruiz made it 21-21 with 56 minutes on the clock.
items.raw_description: Skipper Pablo Matera scored two tries as a brave Argentina effort earned them a 28-28 draw against Australia despite playing for the last 10 minutes with 13 men in the second test in Mendoza on Saturday.

items.title: FRB理事､「ブラックアウト」中に民間銀行イベント出席－異例の面会も
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米連邦準備制度理事会（FRB）の理事2人がここ数カ月間に、対外発信を制限される「ブラックアウト」期間にもかかわらず、民間銀行関係者が主催するイベントに出席するなどしていたことが分かった。

5月と6月の予定が掲載された記録によると、ボウマンFRB副議長（銀行監督担当）は、6月16－17日の連邦公開市場委員会（FOMC）会合の前週に、マサチューセッツ州銀行協会のトップと面会していた。

FRB報道官によれば、ボウマン氏はFOMC会合の翌週に同銀行協会が主催するイベントで講演を行う予定になっていたため、その準備として面会した。

パウエル理事は6月9日、バンク・オブ・ニューヨーク・メロン（BNY）のグローバル取締役会が主催したレセプションに出席。6月FOMCの1週間前だった。パウエル氏は5月にFRB議長を退任した。

FRB報道官によると、パウエル氏はゲストとして招かれ、同イベントで発言する役割はなかった。

ブルームバーグ・ニュースは7月にこれらの記録を請求し、9月4日夕方にFRBが開示した。

FRB当局者は、FOMC開催前の約10日間および会合終了翌日のいわゆるブラックアウト期間中、経済や金融政策に関する自身の見解を公に話すことを禁じられている。

ブルームバーグや他の報道機関はこれまでに、ボウマン副議長が6月FOMC会合の数時間後に、バンク・オブ・アメリカ（BofA）がニューヨークで主催した非公開の夕食会で講演を行ったと報じている。

ボウマン氏はその後の声明で、夕食会では金融政策に関する見解は示していないと説明。「適用される全てのFOMC規則、および倫理規定を一貫して順守しており、今後も厳格に守る考えだ」と述べた。

6月17日の同会合について、ボウマン氏の予定表には「市場参加者からの意見聴取会」と記載されている。

ボウマン氏はまた6月17日、上院銀行委員会に所属するハガティ議員（共和）とも面会していた。6月の予定表によると、この面会は同日のFOMCで決定された政策金利が公表される前だった。

items.title: Oasis llega con estilo a Venecia mientras un documental celebra su reencuentro
items.author: Crispian Balmer
items.creator: Crispian Balmer
items.summary: Liam Gallagher levantó el puño en el aire y su hermano Noel hizo el signo de la victoria cuando las estrellas del rock de Oasis llegaron en taxi acuático al Festival de Cine de Venecia el sábado, antes del estreno de un documental que narra su exitosa gira de reencuentro.
items.body:
Liam Gallagher levantó el puño en el aire y su hermano Noel hizo el signo de la victoria cuando las estrellas del rock de Oasis llegaron en taxi acuático al Festival de Cine de Venecia el sábado, antes del estreno de un documental que narra su exitosa gira de reencuentro.
Cuando un periodista de Reuters les preguntó qué se sentían al estar en Venecia, Liam respondió: "Bíblico, hombre, bíblico". Noel optó por una respuesta más italiana: "Bellissimo2.
Más tarde, Liam se mostró menos impresionado por los fotógrafos que gritaban para llamar su atención. "¿A qué vienen tantos gritos? ¿Es esto lo que se hace en el Festival de Cine de Venecia? ¿Gritarle a la gente?", preguntó.
APOYO DE LOS FANS Y LA RECONCILIACIÓN Oasis, la banda de Mánchester cuyos himnos ayudaron a definir los años noventa antes de que las desavenencias entre los dos hermanos la destrozaran, se reunió el año pasado para una gira por Gran Bretaña, Irlanda, América del Norte y del Sur, Asia y Australia.
El documental "Oasis: Don’t Look Back in Anger" narra la gradual reconciliación de una de las relaciones rotas más famosas de la música a lo largo de semanas de ensayos y meses de gira.
"En cierto modo, se vio cómo se producía esa reconciliación sobre el escenario ante los ojos del mundo", afirmó Dylan Southern, que dirigió la película junto a Will Lovelace.
El deshielo lleva su tiempo. Cuando Liam llega a su primer ensayo, no saluda a nadie de los que le rodean y se marcha bruscamente sin despedirse.
Para subrayar su animadversión mutua, Noel revela que sus respectivos hijos nunca se habían conocido antes de la gira de reencuentro, pero que rápidamente se convirtieron en grandes amigos. Al final de la película, Noel describe a Liam como "encantador", algo que admite que nunca había esperado oírse decir a sí mismo.
Los realizadores afirmaron que evitaron deliberadamente interferir, manteniéndose prácticamente invisibles durante las largas sesiones de ensayo y dejando que los acontecimientos se desarrollaran con naturalidad.
A medida que el rodaje se trasladaba a los estadios de conciertos, Southern explicó que el enfoque se amplió para incluir a los fans, cuyo cariño se convirtió en parte integral del acercamiento entre los hermanos.
Steven Knight, autor del guion, afirmó que los realizadores no tenían forma de saber si la reunión tendría éxito, pero siempre esperaron que la historia se convirtiera en una historia de perdón.
"Desde el principio, queríamos que esta fuera una película sobre la reconciliación, la redención y el perdón", afirmó, añadiendo que era poco probable que ninguno de los Gallagher expresara sus emociones abiertamente.
"Son hombres británicos de clase trabajadora, así que no van a chocar las manos, ni a abrazarse, ni a llorar", señaló.
Knight, que está escribiendo el guion de la próxima película de James Bond, afirmó que la historia real de la gira de Oasis resultó más cautivadora que cualquier cosa que él pudiera haber escrito.
"Esto es mejor que cualquier ficción que se pudiera escribir", afirmó. Southern intervino: "Y nadie podría interpretar a Liam Gallagher excepto el propio Liam Gallagher".
La película se proyecta fuera de competición en el Festival de Cine de Venecia, que se celebra hasta el 12 de septiembre.

items.title: Putin comunica a enviados EEUU Witkoff y Kushner que la situación en Ucrania es "difícil"
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: El presidente ruso, Vladímir Putin, se reunió el sábado en el Kremlin con los enviados estadounidenses Steve Witkoff y Jared Kushner, y les dijo al inicio de las conversaciones que la situación en Ucrania es "difícil".
items.body:
El presidente ruso, Vladímir Putin, se reunió el sábado en el Kremlin con los enviados estadounidenses Steve Witkoff y Jared Kushner, y les dijo al inicio de las conversaciones que la situación en Ucrania es "difícil".
Putin elogió los esfuerzos del presidente de EEUU, Donald Trump, por poner fin a la guerra de cuatro años y medio en Ucrania. Trump sugirió el viernes que EEUU tenía una nueva propuesta destinada a poner fin a la guerra. No dio más detalles.
"Aunque es consciente de que se enfrenta a una situación difícil, no por ello cesa en sus esfuerzos por contribuir a alcanzar un acuerdo y aportar su granito de arena a la resolución del conflicto ruso-ucraniano", afirmó Putin.
Al igual que en reuniones anteriores, Putin estuvo flanqueado por su asesor de política exterior, Yuri Ushakov, y su enviado para inversiones, Kirill Dmitriev, quienes recibieron a los dos visitantes en el aeropuerto, los llevaron a un restaurante y, posteriormente, los acompañaron al Kremlin.
El portavoz del Kremlin, Dmitry Peskov, afirmó en un comunicado publicado en el canal del Kremlin en la aplicación de mensajería Max que Putin había ordenado al ejército no atacar Kiev durante tres días, a partir de la medianoche del sábado, en relación con la visita de Witkoff y Kushner a la capital ucraniana.
Putin señaló en sus comentarios iniciales que la intensidad de los ataques ucranianos contra Rusia también ha disminuido y prometió garantizar la seguridad de los negociadores estadounidenses. Afirmó que Rusia aún no había aceptado un alto el fuego más amplio de tres días.
El presidente ucraniano, Volodímir Zelenski, declaró que había hablado con los dos enviados estadounidenses que tenían previsto visitar Ucrania el domingo, y añadió que Ucrania estaba dispuesta a abstenerse de lanzar ataques contra Moscú hasta el lunes.
UNA ENORME DISTANCIA ENTRE LAS POSTURAS El Ministerio de Defensa ruso informó de la presencia de 53 drones ucranianos en el espacio aéreo ruso el sábado, una cifra significativamente inferior a la media registrada en los últimos meses. Moscú celebra este sábado el Día de la Ciudad, con cientos de miles de personas participando en festividades al aire libre por toda la ciudad.
Sigue existiendo un enorme abismo entre Rusia y Ucrania sobre cómo poner fin a la guerra, la más mortífera en Europa desde la Segunda Guerra Mundial.
Una fuente cercana al Kremlin, que habló antes de que surgieran las noticias sobre un posible viaje de los enviados de Trump, afirmó que Putin seguía decidido a conquistar más territorio.
"No hay ninguna posibilidad de llegar a un acuerdo sobre la línea del frente hasta que Putin termine de asegurar la parte restante de la región de Donetsk", declaró la fuente a Reuters, añadiendo que el líder del Kremlin confiaba —basándose en los informes de sus comandantes— en que esto ocurriría antes de que acabara el año.
LA POSTURA DEL KREMLIN ES «INQUEBRANTABLE» Los analistas militares occidentales consideran que esa posibilidad es remota, dado el lento ritmo de avance de Moscú. Ucrania se ha negado a ceder el territorio que ha defendido con éxito a un enorme coste, y rechaza tales condiciones por considerarlas equivalentes a una rendición.
El Kremlin afirmó el viernes que la postura que Putin expuso en un discurso hace dos años —según la cual Ucrania debería ceder la totalidad del territorio de las cuatro regiones reclamadas por Rusia y abandonar su plan de adherirse a la OTAN— era "inquebrantable".
Desde las últimas negociaciones de paz en febrero, ambas partes han intensificado los ataques aéreos de largo alcance en lo más profundo del territorio contrario, mientras que la guerra en el mar también se ha recrudecido.
Sobre el terreno, las líneas del frente se han mantenido prácticamente estables, y Rusia solo ha logrado avances graduales en su intento de apoderarse de toda la región ucraniana de Donbás.
Los ataques con drones de Ucrania contra refinerías de petróleo rusas han provocado un verano de escasez de combustible y subida de precios para los conductores rusos, mientras que unos 30 ataques contra gigantescos almacenes pertenecientes en su mayoría a Wildberries, el mayor minorista en línea del país, han afectado a la economía de consumo.

items.body:
El estadounidense Taylor Fritz quedó eliminado el sábado en la tercera ronda del Abierto de Estados Unidos, tras perder ante el argentino Francisco Cerúndolo por 3-6, 4-6, 6-3, 6-4 y 6-4, lo que supone su eliminación más temprana en este torneo de Grand Slam en su país en cuatro años.
Fritz no había cedido ni un solo set en las dos rondas anteriores y parecía uno de los principales candidatos a poner fin a una sequía de 23 años sin que un estadounidense ganara un Grand Slam, pero Cerúndolo sacó lo mejor de sí mismo para alcanzar por primera vez la cuarta ronda del Abierto de Estados Unidos.
"No sé cómo he dejado que eso pasara hoy", declaró Fritz con el ceño fruncido a los periodistas en la rueda de prensa posterior al partido.
"Jugó mucho mejor que yo en los dos primeros sets", afirmó Cerúndolo, que jugó por primera vez en el estadio Arthur Ashe y ahora se enfrentará al belga Alexander Blockx, quien dio la sorpresa al derrotar al italiano Flavio Cobolli.
"Empecé a meterme en el partido poco a poco y creo que en el cuarto y el quinto set jugué muy bien al tenis. No había encontrado ese nivel en los sets anteriores, ni en las rondas anteriores".
Fritz había superado con facilidad su partido de segunda ronda en poco más de 90 minutos y parecía encaminado hacia otra victoria sin complicaciones, salvando 11 de los 13 puntos de break a los que se enfrentó en los dos primeros sets.
Pero tras un intercambio de breaks al principio del tercer set, el argentino se plantó firme, y el subcampeón de 2024 parecía exasperado cuando lanzó un golpe torcido más allá de la línea de fondo en un punto de break en el sexto juego.
Cerúndolo elevó su nivel mientras Fritz se veía afectado por errores poco habituales en el cuarto set, y el estadounidense golpeó su raqueta contra el muslo tras enviar otro golpe largo en un punto de break en el quinto juego.
El argentino hizo que su rival corriera de un lado a otro de la línea de fondo con una serie de potentes golpes de precisión en el noveno juego del último set, donde a Fritz se le rompió el cordón del zapato mientras sacaba con un 15-40 en contra.
La breve interrupción no sirvió para frenar el ímpetu de Cerúndolo y Fritz envió la pelota a la red, regalándole a su rival el break en el siguiente punto. El argentino selló la victoria con un magnífico golpe de revés.
Fritz fue la última baja entre los favoritos del torneo masculino, quedando ya solo cuatro de los diez primeros cabezas de serie en el cuadro.

items.title: Notebook: Chase Briscoe eyes third straight at Darlington
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Chase Briscoe smiled and conceded he never really had held a specific love for Darlington (S.C.) Raceway, the track nicknamed "Too Tough to Tame." But a 2020 win in the NASCAR O'Reilly Auto Parts Series capped with back-to-back trips to Victory Lane for winning the last two Southern 500s, certainly solidified the historic track as one of his all-time favorites.
items.body:
Chase Briscoe smiled and conceded he never really had held a specific love for Darlington (S.C.) Raceway, the track nicknamed "Too Tough to Tame." But a 2020 win in the NASCAR O'Reilly Auto Parts Series capped with back-to-back trips to Victory Lane for winning the last two Southern 500s, certainly solidified the historic track as one of his all-time favorites.
This Sunday, Briscoe can tie NASCAR Hall of Famer Jeff Gordon as the only drivers to win the Southern 500 for three consecutive years. And he's very aware of what a victory in Sunday's Cook Out Southern 500 (5 p.m. ET, USA Network, MRN, SiriusXM NASCAR Radio) would mean -- for prosperity and for his current championship run.
"To do that three times in a row would be something really, really special," Briscoe said. "So definitely it's on the radar. One of my favorite races of the year, but certainly, also still aware, just of the situation: you can't wreck trying to win this deal, just with the points and the Chase and everything else."
Briscoe led four laps and finished 12th here in the Spring. The driver of the No. 19 Joe Gibbs Racing Toyota goes into this opening race of the 16-driver, 10-race 2026 championship run ranked fifth, 45 points behind leader and JGR teammate Denny Hamlin. He is only 20 points behind second place, Team Penske's Ryan Blaney.
"Just something about this place has always just kind of fit my driving style, I guess," Briscoe added. "I think the first time I ran here was like 2018 or ‘19 in the Xfinity car, and I just remember coming here in my first five laps on the racetrack, thinking man, this place is awesome.
"Like it just fit how I drive for whatever reason. So, I've always just loved this place and yeah, it's been probably the best track for me statistically in my career, I would say, definitely across the Cup Series.
--Reddick ready
Tyler Reddick put together one of the most impressive season starts in the sport's recent history -- claiming his first Daytona 500 win and then hoisting trophies at the next two consecutive races. The driver of the No. 45 23XI Racing Toyota has won five times -- a personal single season high -- and at one point held a 129-point advantage over Denny Hamlin 12 races into the season.
Among his triumphant early season work was a victory in the Darlington 400-miler -- from pole position.
But a tough-luck spring-into-summer stretch for the No. 45 team, allowed his team co-owner Hamlin to rally past and claim the regular season title. And he'll now start with a 35-point advantage over Reddick, who sits third in the championship standings.
But with four finishes of 11th or better in the last five races, including a pole position and third-place run at Daytona last week, Reddick still enters the Chase portion of the schedule feeling hopeful that he can win his first series title.
With weather forcing the cancellation of Saturday's Busch Light Pole Qualifying at Darlington, Reddick will start from pole position for the eighth time this year.
"I don't think we need to flip a switch or do anything," Reddick said of overcoming the rough mid-summer stretch. "We are going to be rolling back into tracks where we have won at, where we have led laps at, where we are extremely fast at.
"All things seem to be going the right direction at the right time," he added. "It would have been great to hang on to the points lead. It would have been great to not fight the things that we did, but as much as the bad finishes were hard on our standing in the points, we learned a lot from it and with this Chase, the gap is gone and we are seeded and we are going to go now."
"We learned a lot about ourselves when we weren't great," he said. "I sternly believe every team in this Chase is going to face some adversity. ... to stay locked in like we have, if we have situations come up in the Chase, we're going to be ready for it. We'll know how to handle it."
--Preece still smiling
Last week's winner in the Daytona International Speedway regular season finale, RFK Racing's Ryan Preece was still grinning Saturday afternoon in Darlington. The 35-year old Connecticut native rallied from 17th place in the standings before the race to hoisting a trophy in Victory Lane afterward -- making up 31 points in the standings to claim that final championship position.
This Sunday marks his first ever appearance in the Chase and he likes his chances, especially considering he's coming off such a big win -- the first points-paying victory of his career
"I'm happy I have my voice back, well, kind of anyways," said Preece, the driver of the No. 60 RFK Ford Mustang. "I definitely felt like I made it a heck of a week, but it's business as usual. It's nice to know the final 10 weeks we're racing for something. We'll try to go on a run. We definitely have momentum on our side."
Preece has scored top-10 finishes in three of the last five races and led laps both in a ninth place finish at New Hampshire two weeks ago and at Daytona. Even 100 points down to the championship leader Hamlin as the points re-set, he's going into the weekend feeling as optimistic as he possibly can. As the most recent race winner, no one has more momentum.
"How you feel as a race car driver when you show up every week, that is real," Preece said of the momentum. "You show up and if you've had three or four weeks where you've wrecked in a row, I mean, the month of June it felt like I couldn't do anything right and if you think it doesn't affect you as a driver, you're lying to yourself. You're just going into a race thinking, ‘Man, I just want to finish this one.'
"So, for me, being aggressive -- Loudon is the one I'll look at because we had a strong car there and we were around the top five, top three all day for the most part. So, that's why when I look at Darlington I think, why not? If we can pick up where we left off last week and have a strong run here, who knows?"
*OF NOTE. .... NASCAR formally recognized NASCAR O'Reilly Auto Parts Series driver Jeremy Clements for becoming the series all-time starts leader. In June he eclipsed Kenny Wallace's mark (547) for most green flags in the series and goes into Saturday night's race at his home track, Darlington, extending his record to 555 races.
--By Holly Cain, NASCAR Wire Service

items.title: Christian Koss, Rafael Devers homer twice as Giants power past Mets
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Christian Koss and Rafael Devers both hit two homers Saturday to help the visiting San Francisco Giants beat the New York Mets 9-5 in the middle game of a three-game series.
items.body:
Christian Koss and Rafael Devers both hit two homers Saturday to help the visiting San Francisco Giants beat the New York Mets 9-5 in the middle game of a three-game series.
Anthony Molina and five relievers combined on a five-hitter for the Giants (59-84), who halted a two-game skid.
A.J. Ewing hit a two-run homer off Molina for the Mets (64-78), whose two-game winning streak ended. Brett Baty had three RBIs via a bases-loaded walk and a two-run double, and Jared Young finished with two hits.
Devers homered in the first off Zac Thornton (3-5) before Koss, batting ninth, put the Giants ahead for good with a two-run shot against Thornton in the third. With two outs in the fifth, Koss hit a solo blast against Thornton to begin a three-run rally that ended with Devers' two-run opposite-field home run.
Koss has gone deep three times in his last nine games after going without a homer in his first 43 games this season.
Devers has six homers in his last six games.
Cleanup batter Oslevis Basabe hit a two-run homer for San Francisco in the eighth, and Grant McCray added a solo shot in the ninth. McCray finished 2-for-4.
Ewing's second-inning homer was the only hit allowed by Molina (3-0), who was charged with two unearned runs over five innings. An error by Devers at first base extended the second.
Molina walked one and struck out six while winning his third consecutive appearance (second start).
Reiver Sanmartin threw a perfect sixth before the Mets threatened against Sanmartin, Joel Kuhnel and Carson Seymour in the seventh.
With one out, Young and Marcus Semien singled and Ewing walked. Kuhnel struck out Francisco Alvarez before Seymour walked Baty with the bases loaded. Seymour avoided further damage by retiring Francisco Lindor on a grounder to first.
Baty narrowly missed a three-run homer in the ninth, settling for the two-RBI double off the top of the left field wall.
Thornton gave up six runs on seven hits and one walk while striking out six over five innings. He has allowed three or fewer runs in nine of his first 11 career starts and had a 2.53 ERA in his previous 10 starts.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Cerundolo sees wide-open men's field after Fritz upset at US Open
items.author: Janina Rios
items.creator: Janina Rios
items.summary: Argentine Francisco Cerundolo believes this is the most wide-open men's field at the U.S. Open in recent memory, highlighting the depth of the tour after securing an extraordinary comeback win over ninth seed and former finalist Taylor Fritz.
items.body:
Argentine Francisco Cerundolo believes this is the most wide-open men's field at the U.S. Open in recent memory, highlighting the depth of the tour after securing an extraordinary comeback win over ninth seed and former finalist Taylor Fritz.
The 24th seed fought back from two sets and a break down against the American to claim a 3-6 4-6 6-3 6-4 6-4 victory over his fellow 28-year-old in Saturday's opening match at Arthur Ashe Stadium and spring one of the upsets of the tournament.
With only four top-10 seeds left in the draw, Cerundolo said he sees a remarkably similar level across the men's tour.
"It shows you how even the circuit is right now, how tight every match is, how difficult it is to win matches, because anything can happen right now," he told reporters.
"A lot of players are playing good. The level, it's super tight. It's open to everyone. Everyone can win."
Fritz was not the only big name to fall early in New York, with Novak Djokovic, Felix Auger-Aliassime and Alex de Minaur among the other seeds already sent packing at Flushing Meadows.
In the next round Cerundolo will face Belgium's Alexander Blockx, who also pulled off an upset of his own by eliminating Italian fifth seed Flavio Cobolli later on Saturday.
With the draw blown wide open, Cerundolo, who has reached the fourth round in New York for the first time, is confident he can ride the momentum to make his deepest Grand Slam run.
"I'm going for more, I'm not settling," he said in an interview for Argentine media.
The South American will be seeking revenge against Blockx, having lost to the Belgian in their only previous meeting in the last 16 at the Madrid Masters 1000 earlier this year.

items.title: Swiatek happy to swap noisy Ashe spotlight for intimate Grandstand
items.author: Shrivathsa Sridhar
items.creator: Shrivathsa Sridhar
items.summary: Arthur Ashe Stadium's noise and spectacle are a big part of the U.S. Open's appeal but Iga Swiatek said on Saturday that she did not mind swapping the tournament's biggest, most boisterous venue for the more intimate surroundings of the Grandstand.
items.body:
Arthur Ashe Stadium's noise and spectacle are a big part of the U.S. Open's appeal but Iga Swiatek said on Saturday that she did not mind swapping the tournament's biggest, most boisterous venue for the more intimate surroundings of the Grandstand.
With a capacity of nearly 24,000, the main showcourt is the beating heart of the year's final Grand Slam and one of tennis's loudest stages, dwarfing the outside venue where Swiatek secured a 7-6(3) 7-6(3) third-round victory over Marie Bouzkova.
However, the Polish eighth seed said she was comfortable playing in front of a little over 8,000 fans in a picturesque stadium.
"Well, Ashe is really alive. Sometimes too much, I'd say," Swiatek told reporters.
"This court is nice. Honestly, I don't see any negatives about it. It has fewer screens. It's smaller in a way that's more normal, I would say, because Ashe is huge. The court seems small compared to the green part that you have around it.
"It's not easy to play on that court. The Grandstand seems nice and normal, a nice court. I don't really mind, honestly."
Swiatek was not alone in finding Flushing Meadows' biggest stages slightly overwhelming.
After his 6-7(4) 6-3 6-0 6-3 defeat by Belgian Alexander Blockx on Louis Armstrong Stadium, Italy's fifth seed Flavio Cobolli said the noise levels at the U.S. Open were unlike anything that players typically encounter on the tour.
"I said the first day, we always play with the silence. We're always used to playing with nobody moving, nobody talking, with a great atmosphere," Cobolli said.
"Here it's really different. We have a great atmosphere, but it's very, very loud. For us, it's very tough to play.
"Maybe we have to play like this for more weeks (on tour), because if you come here and there's a different rule, it's very tough for us. I didn't lose because of the noise, of course."

items.title: Top 25 roundup: No. 1 Ohio State blasts Ball State
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Wide receiver Jeremiah Smith caught two TD passes and No. 1 Ohio State ran through Ball State in Columbus, Ohio, on Saturday, 56-3, in the teams' season opener.
items.body:
Wide receiver Jeremiah Smith caught two TD passes and No. 1 Ohio State ran through Ball State in Columbus, Ohio, on Saturday, 56-3, in the teams' season opener.
The Buckeyes' prep for a showdown at No. 5 Texas turned into a highlight reel. Julian Sayin passed for 320 yards and three touchdowns, completed 21 of 25 passes and chipped in another touchdown on the ground.
Smith caught eight passes for 151 yards and Devin McCuin added six catches for 97 yards and a score. Ohio State produced three scoring drives of 90-plus yards and another of 83 while limiting Ball State to 165 total yards.
Keldric Luster hit 18 of 33 for 89 yards and one interception for the Cardinals while Brody Boehm booted a 54-yard field goal with 1:17 left in the first half to account for the visitors' points.
No. 6 Indiana 52, North Texas 16
Bloodied but unbowed, Josh Hoover made a convincing debut as the heir to Heisman Trophy winner Fernando Mendoza and the Hoosiers extended their FBS-leading winning streak to 17 games.
Hoover threw a touchdown on his first pass attempt, Charlie Becker caught two TD passes and defending national champion Indiana won its 16th consecutive home game. Hoover, a transfer from TCU, ended with his ninth career game with at least four TD passes.
Becker made a diving catch to give Indiana a 21-3 lead three plays after Hoover's nose was bloodied on a 15-yard facemask penalty on North Texas' Udoka Ezeani.
No. 13 Alabama 48, East Carolina 10
The Crimson Tide scored on their first five drives and dominated the visiting Pirates with 480 total yards in sophomore quarterback Keelon Russell's first career start.
Russell and wide receiver Ryan Coleman-Williams hooked up five times for 130 yards despite a pair of drops and a lost fumble.
Alabama led 38-7 at halftime. Russell had 249 passing yards and ran for 86 yards and a touchdown.
No. 23 Houston 33, Oregon State 20
Conner Weigman ran for a 1-yard touchdown with 5:01 left to help the Cougars hold off the Beavers.
Weigman hit 20 of 30 passes for 305 yards and tossed an interception as the Cougars rolled up 533 total yards. Amare Thomas caught a game-high eight passes for 133 yards and a score. Makhi Hughes added 98 yards and a touchdown on 17 carries.
Braden Atkinson helped keep the Beavers within striking distance until the final minutes, completing 29 of 48 passes for 376 yards and a score. He spread his completions among nine receivers, with freshman Jesse Legree catching five passes for 136 yards and a touchdown.
